Trying to be a Crowd Pleaser?|[[Isaak]] on Wave 11 ([[Competition Court]])|audio = AdidasMission2Wave11-1.ogg}} }} ==Description== The '''Crowd Pleaser''' was an enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had decent health and above average speed. It had one ability where it will fire an ice projectile at a tower or unit in its range of 20. This will freeze towers for 2 seconds and deal 400 damage to units. ==Appearance== The '''Crowd Pleaser''' has grey skin and vibrant pink hair. It wears a pink T-shirt with a black adidas logo on the left side of said T-shirt. There are vertical white stripes on the T-shirt and the collar of the T-shirt is a slightly darker shade of pink compared to the regular coloring of Crowd Pleasers T-shirt. The '''Crowd Pleaser''' is also wearing black shorts raised slightly above its waist while also wearing black shoes with a miniature line-like design starting from the sides up until the toe cap. It is also seen holding a blue snowball gun. ==Mutation== ===Hard Mission 2=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |10% |80 |- !Wave !Health |- |12 |880 |- |13 |960 |- |14 |1,040 |- |15 |1,120 |} ===Hard Mission 3=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |10% |100 |- !Wave !Health |- |12 |1,100 |- |13 |1,200 |- |14 |1,300 |- |15 |1,400 |- |16 |1,500 |- |17 |1,600 |- |18 |1,700 |- |19 |1,800 |- |20 |1,900 |} ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CrowdPleaserCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CrowdPleaserIconIG.png|'''Crowd Pleaser''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Crowd Pleaser''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The '''Crowd Pleaser''' reuses the [[Null Freezer]]'s ability, **Uniquely, its animations are not made for it or taken from an existing enemy, but instead are actually from the [[Rifleman]] unit. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Crowd Pleaser''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Crowd Pleaser's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. **{{Bug}} '''Crowd Pleaser''' blocks tower placement near it, blocked area has [[Damage Indicators]] appear in it. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. **{{Bugfix}} No longer blocks tower placement. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Crowd Pleaser''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{CompetitionCourt|[[Referee]]|Wave 10 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Referee]] & [[Soccer Speedy]]|hardw1 = Wave 10 (Hard)|Crowd Pleaser|Wave 11|[[Decoy]]|Wave 13}} {{VictoryField|[[Referee]]|Wave 10|Crowd Pleaser|Wave 11|[[Decoy]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
